title: Men Playing Baseball at Outdoor Picnic, 1950s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A dynamic outdoor black and white snapshot capturing a group of men playing baseball or softball during a casual gathering or company picnic in the 1950s. The foreground subject, annotated on the reverse as 'Dad's Boss,' is poised mid-throw holding a ball while wearing a leather glove on his left hand and dressed in a tailored short-sleeve camp collar shirt and matching trousers. Two other colleagues play catch in the background amid a sunny, wooded clearing, highlighting the mid-century tradition of corporate recreational culture and outdoor leisure.
